from.place: Auxiliary degree-zero Hom lemma needed by the extension-classification helper: the single-complex embedding into the derived category is fully faithful.

title: The single-complex embedding of an abelian category is fully faithful
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $S:\mathcal A\to D(\mathcal A)$ send $A$ to the complex $A[0]$ concentrated in degree zero and a morphism $f$ to its degree-zero single-complex map. Then $S$ is fully faithful: for every $A,B\in\mathcal A$, the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(A,B)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(A[0],B[0])$, $f\mapsto S(f)$, is bijective.
